environment.browser: Google Chrome headless, controlled with Playwright
environment.data_isolation: Fresh disposable browser context; only synthetic demo/QA records; profile closed after capture; no owner browser profile or user database was opened.

workflow: Created a synthetic Web Application project through the UI with title, description, context, solution, work steps, role, result, metric, technologies, tag, and featured state.
Combined title search, type, status, tag, and featured filters; exactly one card matched.
Opened the case and confirmed its narrative, tag, technology, and metadata were visible.
Edited the description through the UI and confirmed it persisted after a normal reload.

Disabled network in the isolated browser context, reloaded through the active Service Worker, and confirmed HTTP 200 plus the edited record still present; network was restored before closing the profile.
Pressed Tab 40 times inside the detail dialog: zero focus events escaped. Escape closed the dialog and restored focus to the originating project card.
At 1440x900, 390x844, and 320x568, document scroll width equalled client width.
limitations: Chromium viewport emulation is not physical-phone acceptance.
No real screen reader was used.
At 320x568, the case dialog is internally scrollable; the screenshot shows only the viewport portion.
